shrinkage_experiment.formula: weight_current = n / (n + k), where n = minutes / 90
shrinkage_experiment.rationale: Shrinkage k=0.1 robustly outperformed games/5 across historical season transitions. It avoids discarding prior-season baselines early in the year while adapting smoothly as minutes accumulate.

leakage_checks.method: Automated independent recomputation of rolling form without pipeline shift() on high-variance historical players

bugs_caught.title: Double-Gameweek Row Duplication Bug
bugs_caught.discovery: Double gameweeks created two rows for the same player-GW, causing shift(1) to count the same gameweek twice and shifting historical windows erroneously.
bugs_caught.fix: Aggregated all fixtures in a gameweek into a single player-GW row before running the rolling pipeline.

bugs_caught.title: Season Boundary Form Bleed Bug
bugs_caught.discovery: Rolling form was bleeding across season boundaries, mixing previous season's GW38 (May) with new season's GW1 (August).
bugs_caught.fix: Strict groupby(['element', 'season']) to force rolling buffers to reset cleanly at each season boundary.

rejected_ideas.title: Per-Position Independent Models
rejected_ideas.hypothesis: Training 4 separate models (GKP, DEF, MID, FWD) allows position-specific feature weights without cross-position dilution.
rejected_ideas.experiment: Trained 4 separate RF models on single-position slices vs 1 shared RF with position one-hot dummies over 2024-25 walk-forward backtest.
rejected_ideas.metric_comparison: Shared RF MAE: 1.027 vs Per-Position RF MAE: 1.048 (+0.021 higher error).
rejected_ideas.reason: Position splitting fragments the dataset, reducing effective sample size per model. The shared model generalizes better by discovering universal minutes and form relationships.

rejected_ideas.title: Explicit Stat x Position Interaction Features
rejected_ideas.hypothesis: Adding explicit interactions (e.g. clean_sheets x DEF, goals x FWD) helps the shared model weight stats appropriately by role.
rejected_ideas.experiment: Engineered 8 explicit interaction pairs into Random Forest vs baseline feature set on 2024-25 walk-forward backtest.
rejected_ideas.metric_comparison: Baseline MAE: 1.027 vs Explicit Interactions MAE: 1.029 (no gain).
rejected_ideas.reason: Tree-based ensembles already perform recursive hierarchical splits that natively capture interactions. Explicit products added redundant dimensions and mild noise.

rejected_ideas.title: Bench-Quality Reliability & Points Bonus in Objective
rejected_ideas.hypothesis: Adding secondary rewards for squad-wide minutes reliability and bench scoring prevents fielding inactive substitutes.
rejected_ideas.experiment: Grid search over reliability_weight (0 to 1.0) and points_weight (0 to 0.5) evaluated on REALIZED points across 3 seasons (2022-23 to 2024-25).
rejected_ideas.metric_comparison: 2 of 3 seasons favored 0 bonus. Aggregate best combo beat doing nothing by only 0.16% (within random variance).
rejected_ideas.reason: Starting XI and captain deliver >90% of all points. Diverting budget or selections to buffer the bench degrades starting XI quality.

rejected_ideas.title: Removing 'Value' (Price) as a Predictive Feature
rejected_ideas.hypothesis: Player price might introduce circularity or proxy bias rather than capturing genuine underlying performance.
rejected_ideas.experiment: Ablation test: Random Forest 2024-25 walk-forward backtest WITH value vs WITHOUT value.
rejected_ideas.metric_comparison: WITH value MAE: 1.027 vs WITHOUT value MAE: 1.062 (+0.035 higher error).
rejected_ideas.reason: Price is an extremely strong market consensus signal reflecting player quality, tactical role, and starting security.

rejected_ideas.title: Price-Trend Override Rules
rejected_ideas.hypothesis: Preemptively transferring in players rising in price to build team value.
rejected_ideas.experiment: Tested prioritizing price change velocity over predicted point gains in transfer simulations.
rejected_ideas.metric_comparison: Resulted in lower end-of-season total points due to premature transfers and missed fixture opportunities.
rejected_ideas.reason: Points are the ultimate objective; team value is merely a tool. Chasing price rises sacrificed net points.

rejected_ideas.title: Manual Player Exclusion Blacklists
rejected_ideas.hypothesis: Maintaining a manual blacklist of out-of-favor or rotated players to override model outputs.
rejected_ideas.experiment: Compared manual player exclusions against objective data-driven thresholding (blended_avg_minutes < 20).
rejected_ideas.metric_comparison: Manual overrides suffered from cognitive bias and frequently missed surprise returns.
rejected_ideas.reason: The system's core strength is mathematical discipline. Objective minutes filtering (< 20 mins) strictly outperformed subjective curation.
